 Log in Intra-division trade sends catcher Fortes to Red Sox from Rays
 8 minutes ago MLB.com
 Share share-square--:R1qlq: The Red Sox are keeping busy early on this offseason, acquiring catcher Nick Fortes in a trade with the Rays, the clubs announced on Wednesday. The Rays are receiving 17-year-old right-hander Angel Roa in return. 
 The trade adds some depth at the backstop position for Boston behind starter Adley Rutschman, who came over in a Trade Deadline blockbuster last season.

 Fortes appeared in 109 games with Tampa Bay in 2026, slashing .258/.304/.376 with six homers and 35 RBIs. He appeared in five games in the Rays' run to the Fall Classic, but mostly ceded time to Liam Hicks during the postseason. 
 With another catcher being added to the roster, Connor Wong was designated for assignment in a corresponding move. 
 Boston has already made the biggest move of the offseason so far by signing free agent Jake Bauers to a four-year deal .
